news.titleEn: Brent oil tops $109 after Houthi militants claim they attacked Saudi airports and Aramco facilities
news.conclusionEn: Brent settled near $109.55, close to a five-month high, while WTI jumped 2.2% to $103.66 after Houthi strikes on Saudi energy and airport targets.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特设施，布油站稳109美元附近
news.whyEn: With Hormuz flows already cut to roughly 8.5 million barrels a day, any new hit to Gulf supply feeds directly into global inflation and central-bank decisions.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹运量已大幅缩水，新的供应冲击直接推高全球通胀压力
news.detailEn: Houthi forces said they targeted an Aramco site in Yanbu plus Saudi airports and a military base. Brent briefly hit $110.70 before profit-taking, while WTI posted its highest settlement since mid-September. Crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz fell to a seven-day average of about 8.5 million bpd last week amid at least 10 attacks on vessels. Analysts warn Iran could escalate further before the November 3 US midterms.
news.detailZh: 胡塞武装称袭击了沙特延布的阿美设施、多个机场和一处军事基地。布油盘中一度触及110.70美元后回落，美油则创9月中旬以来最高收盘。上周霍尔木兹海峡原油七日均运量降至约850万桶/日，期间至少发生10起船只遇袭事件。分析师警告，伊朗可能在11月3日美国中期选举前进一步升级行动。

news.titleEn: Tech stocks had a nice oversold bounce on Monday. Earnings this week will determine if it's for real
news.conclusionEn: The Nasdaq rose 1.1% and the S&P 500 0.4% on Monday as chip stocks bounced after last week's AI-debt rout, though CoreWeave slipped again.
news.conclusionZh: AI股暴跌后反弹，纳指周一涨1.1%
news.whyEn: Whether this is a real bottom depends on this week's big-tech earnings and on whether debt worries around AI infrastructure ease.
news.whyZh: 能否真正见底取决于本周科技巨头财报和AI债务担忧是否缓解
news.detailEn: Last week the Nasdaq fell 4.5% and the S&P 500 nearly 2%, driven by fears over debt-funded 'neocloud' firms such as CoreWeave. On Monday Intel gained 2% after a JPMorgan upgrade, AMD rose 1.8% and Micron about 3%, while the chip ETF moved to snap a nine-day losing streak. CoreWeave reversed to a small loss despite a Goldman upgrade. With 76 S&P 500 companies reporting this week, results will test whether the bounce holds.
news.detailZh: 上周纳指累计下跌4.5%，标普500跌近2%，主因是市场担心CoreWeave等依赖举债的「新云」公司。周一英特尔获摩根大通上调评级涨2%，AMD涨1.8%，美光涨约3%，半导体ETF有望结束九连跌。CoreWeave虽获高盛上调评级却转跌。本周有76家标普500公司发布财报，将检验这次反弹能否持续。

news.titleEn: China's GDP expands 4.5 pct year on year in Q3
news.conclusionEn: China's economy grew 4.5% in Q3, up from 4.3% in Q2 and slightly above the 4.4% consensus, with 4.6% growth over the first nine months.
news.conclusionZh: 中国三季度GDP同比增4.5%，略超预期
news.whyEn: Exports and high-tech manufacturing are carrying growth while consumption stays weak, shaping expectations for further Chinese stimulus and global demand.
news.whyZh: 增长靠出口和高技术制造支撑，内需偏弱，影响刺激政策预期
news.detailEn: The National Bureau of Statistics said high-tech manufacturing rose 14.3% and industrial robot output jumped 29.1% in the first nine months. Industrial output rose 5.5% in September, but retail sales grew only 1.1% and property and fixed-asset investment declined. Nine-month growth of 4.6% keeps China within its 4.5%-5% target. The imbalance between strong supply and weak domestic demand is likely to keep pressure on Beijing to support consumption.
news.detailZh: 国家统计局数据显示，前三季度高技术制造业增长14.3%，工业机器人产量增长29.1%。9月工业增加值增长5.5%，但社会消费品零售总额仅增1.1%，房地产和固定资产投资下降。前三季度4.6%的增速使中国处于4.5%-5%的目标区间内。供给强、内需弱的格局，可能让北京继续面临提振消费的压力。

news.titleEn: Treasury yields move lower as investors assess U.S. inflation backdrop
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield edged down to about 5.08% and the 2-year to 4.72%, holding near multi-year highs after last week's hot inflation data.
news.conclusionZh: 美债10年期收益率微降至约5.08%，仍处高位
news.whyEn: Yields above 5% raise borrowing costs for governments, companies and homebuyers, and markets are betting the Fed may need to hike again.
news.whyZh: 5%以上的收益率推高各方融资成本，市场押注美联储或再加息
news.detailEn: Treasuries slumped last week after a hot inflation print lifted bets on further Fed rate hikes. On Monday yields dipped slightly as investors weighed inflation against geopolitical risk from the Middle East. The fed funds target range stands at 3.75%-4.00%, well below the 10-year yield. Elevated long-term rates are a key reason behind both the AI-debt selloff and the slump in housing sentiment.
news.detailZh: 上周通胀数据偏热，推高了美联储进一步加息的押注，美债大跌。周一投资者在通胀和中东地缘风险之间权衡，收益率小幅回落。目前联邦基金利率目标区间为3.75%-4.00%，明显低于10年期收益率。长期利率高企，正是AI债务抛售和房地产信心下滑背后的关键原因。

news.titleEn: US Homebuilder Confidence Falls to 14-Year Low as Sales Slow
news.conclusionEn: The NAHB/Wells Fargo housing index fell 3 points to 29 in October, its lowest since June 2012, as mortgage rates above 7% hit demand.
news.conclusionZh: 美国建商信心跌至29，创2012年以来新低
news.whyEn: Housing is highly rate-sensitive; a deepening slump weighs on construction jobs, home-related spending and overall US growth.
news.whyZh: 地产对利率最敏感，持续下滑将拖累就业、消费和美国经济增长
news.detailEn: The reading missed the 31 consensus, with buyer traffic falling to its lowest since April 2012 excluding the pandemic shock. About 43% of builders cut prices in October, the largest share in the 2020-2026 period, and 65% offered sales incentives. Builders also face labor shortages and high material costs. Unless long-term rates ease, analysts expect housing to remain a drag on the economy.
news.detailZh: 该数据低于市场预期的31，潜在买家客流指标跌至2012年4月以来最低（疫情冲击月份除外）。10月约43%的建商下调了房价，为2020至2026年间最高比例，65%的建商提供购房优惠。建商同时还面临劳动力短缺和材料成本高企。分析人士认为，除非长期利率回落，房地产将继续拖累经济。

news.titleEn: France announces curfews in aftermath of violent protests
news.conclusionEn: France imposed partial curfews in Paris, Lyon, Nice, Lille and other cities after cost-of-living protests turned into looting and arson, with over 2,300 arrests.
news.conclusionZh: 法国生活成本抗议演变成骚乱，多城实施宵禁
news.whyEn: Unrest in the eurozone's second-largest economy, six months before a presidential election, adds political risk to already strained French finances.
news.whyZh: 欧元区第二大经济体动荡，叠加大选临近，加剧法国财政和政治风险
news.detailEn: Student protests over school conditions merged with anger over high prices and weak public services, drawing more than 500,000 people on Saturday. Nearly 1,000 police and gendarmes were injured, and the interior minister admitted police 'lost control'. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu ruled out a citywide Paris curfew but did not exclude a state of emergency. Unions and the Yellow Vests movement plan further protests, and unrest is also spreading to Italy.
news.detailZh: 学生对教育条件的抗议，与民众对高物价和公共服务不足的不满汇合，周六参与人数超过50万。近千名警察和宪兵受伤，内政部长承认警方「失控」。总理勒科尔尼排除了全巴黎宵禁，但未排除宣布紧急状态。工会和「黄背心」运动计划继续抗议，骚乱也正在向意大利蔓延。

news.titleEn: Iran-backed Houthi rebels strike Yemen's government forces with ballistic missiles, killing at least 53
news.conclusionEn: A Houthi ballistic-missile strike on a training camp in Yemen's Shabwa province killed at least 53 recruits and wounded about 200.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞导弹袭击也门政府军营地，至少53人死亡
news.whyEn: It is one of the deadliest attacks since Yemen's war reignited, and the Houthi-Saudi escalation threatens Red Sea shipping and Gulf oil supply.
news.whyZh: 也门战火升级，威胁红海航运和海湾石油供应
news.detailEn: The missiles struck while recruits for internal security forces were lining up for training. The 2022 ceasefire collapsed when fighting resumed in February as part of the wider Iran conflict. Weekend airstrikes blamed on the Saudi-led coalition killed at least nine people in Saada, including five children. The Houthis have also hit Saudi airports and Aramco sites and seized ground near the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint.
news.detailZh: 导弹落下时，内部安全部队的新兵正在列队训练。今年2月随着更大范围的伊朗冲突爆发，也门战事重启，2022年的停火协议随之破裂。周末被指由沙特联军发动的空袭在萨达省造成至少9人死亡，其中有5名儿童。胡塞武装还袭击了沙特机场和阿美设施，并占领了曼德海峡附近的战略要地。

news.titleEn: Merck KGaA to Buy Silence Therapeutics for $1.1 Billion
news.conclusionEn: Germany's Merck KGaA agreed to buy RNA-drug developer Silence Therapeutics for $20 per ADS in cash, a 130% premium, valuing equity at about $1.3 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 默克集团以溢价130%收购Silence Therapeutics
news.whyEn: Big pharma keeps paying steep premiums for promising late-stage assets, showing biotech M&A is accelerating despite volatile markets.
news.whyZh: 大药企高溢价抢购后期资产，显示生物科技并购在加速
news.detailEn: The main prize is divesiran, an siRNA therapy for the rare blood cancer polycythemia vera that posted strong Phase 2 data. The deal carries an enterprise value of about $1.1 billion and is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027. Merck KGaA gains a foothold in RNA interference, a fast-growing drug class. The premium underlines how large drugmakers are buying innovation to refill pipelines ahead of patent expirations.
news.detailZh: 此次收购的核心资产是divesiran，一种用于治疗罕见血癌真性红细胞增多症的siRNA疗法，二期数据表现突出。交易企业价值约11亿美元，预计2027年一季度完成。默克借此进入快速增长的RNA干扰药物领域。高额溢价说明，大药企正通过收购创新来补充产品管线，应对专利到期。

news.titleEn: Meta, Tesla earnings preview: Week of Oct. 19
news.conclusionEn: Netflix reports Tuesday and Tesla Wednesday, with Meta also on deck in a week where 76 S&P 500 companies post results.
news.conclusionZh: 本周奈飞、特斯拉、Meta将密集公布财报
news.whyEn: After the AI selloff, these results will show whether big tech spending and profits justify valuations, setting the market's direction.
news.whyZh: AI股抛售后，巨头财报将决定市场方向和估值能否站稳
news.detailEn: Netflix reports after the bell on Tuesday, October 20, with analysts expecting EPS of about $0.82, and investors focused on advertising and pricing. Tesla follows on Wednesday, with LSEG data pointing to a roughly 14.5% drop in EPS and a slight revenue decline. Investors will look past deliveries to margins and spending on autonomy and robotics. Meta's AI capital spending plans will be closely watched given the market's new sensitivity to AI debt.
news.detailZh: 奈飞将于10月20日周二盘后发布财报，分析师预计每股收益约0.82美元，投资者关注广告业务和定价。特斯拉周三发布，LSEG数据显示每股收益预计同比下降约14.5%，营收小幅下滑。投资者会越过交付量，关注利润率以及自动驾驶和机器人的投入。鉴于市场对AI债务的敏感度上升，Meta的AI资本支出计划将备受关注。

businessTips.explanationEn: Price elasticity measures how much demand changes when price changes. If a 10% price rise cuts sales by more than 10%, demand is elastic; if sales fall less, it is inelastic. Knowing this tells you whether raising prices will increase or shrink total revenue. It also explains why some firms can pass on rising costs and others cannot.
businessTips.explanationZh: 需求价格弹性衡量价格变化时需求变化的幅度。如果涨价10%导致销量下降超过10%，说明需求有弹性；下降少于10%则缺乏弹性。了解这一点，就能判断涨价会让总收入增加还是减少。它也解释了为什么有些企业能把成本上涨转嫁给顾客，有些却不能。
businessTips.exampleEn: With oil near $110, gasoline demand barely falls in the short run because people still need to drive, so it is inelastic. A restaurant raising prices 15%, by contrast, may see diners switch to cooking at home.
businessTips.exampleZh: 油价接近110美元时，短期内汽油需求几乎不降，因为人们还得开车，这就是缺乏弹性。相反，一家餐厅涨价15%，食客可能直接改为在家做饭。

businessTips.explanationEn: Revenue-based financing lets a small business raise cash and repay it as a fixed percentage of monthly revenue until a set cap is reached. You give up no equity, and repayments shrink automatically in slow months. It suits businesses with steady recurring revenue but little collateral. The trade-off is a total repayment that is usually 1.2-1.5 times the amount borrowed.
businessTips.explanationZh: 基于收入的融资是指小企业先拿到资金，再按每月收入的固定比例还款，直到还满约定上限。你不用出让股权，淡季时还款额也会自动减少。它适合有稳定经常性收入、但缺少抵押物的业务。代价是总还款额通常是借款的1.2到1.5倍。
businessTips.exampleEn: An online course seller earning $20,000 a month borrows $50,000 to fund ads, repaying 8% of monthly revenue until $62,500 is repaid. If sales double, the loan is paid off faster; if they dip, payments drop too.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个月收入2万美元的网课卖家借5万美元投广告，每月按收入的8%还款，直到还满6.25万美元。如果销量翻倍，就能更快还清；如果销量下滑，还款额也随之减少。

businessTips.explanationEn: The interest coverage ratio equals operating profit (EBIT) divided by interest expense. It shows how many times a company can pay its interest bills from earnings. A ratio below about 1.5 signals stress, while above 5 is generally comfortable. When interest rates rise, highly leveraged companies see this ratio fall fastest.
businessTips.explanationZh: 利息覆盖率等于营业利润（EBIT）除以利息支出，反映公司的盈利能支付几倍利息。低于约1.5倍意味着压力较大，高于5倍一般比较安全。利率上升时，高杠杆公司的这一比率下降最快。
businessTips.exampleEn: The recent selloff in debt-heavy AI cloud firms like CoreWeave reflects this worry: with 10-year yields above 5%, refinancing costs rise while earnings are still ramping up. Before buying a leveraged stock, check whether its coverage ratio is trending down.
businessTips.exampleZh: 最近CoreWeave等高负债AI云公司遭抛售，就反映了这种担忧：10年期美债收益率超过5%，再融资成本上升，而盈利仍在爬坡。买入高杠杆股票前，先看看它的利息覆盖率是否在下降。
